description: Find raidcom commands. Use this first when you do not know the exact command name. With no arguments, lists every object (ldev, lun, host_grp, pool, ...) with the actions available on it. With `query` (plain words, e.g. "map a volume to a host group", "grow a pool", "show free ldev ids"), ranks matching commands and rates the confidence of the top result. With `action` and/or `object`, lists exactly those commands. Then call raidcom_describe_command, or raidcom_build_command if you already know the options.

action.description: Only this action: add, delete, get, modify, extend, initialize, set, reset, ...

object.description: Only this object: ldev, lun, host_grp, hba_wwn, pool, dp_pool, port, parity_grp, ...

query.description: What you want to do, in plain words.

name: raidcom_list_commands
title: Find raidcom commands
